description: This file defines the InstallationDatabaseAPI class, a REST API controller responsible for handling database installation requests during the installation process of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It primarily implements a POST request handler to trigger database creation and returns appropriate responses based on success or failure.

classes.name: InstallationDatabaseAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for managing the database installation process during setup. It extends the abstract installer REST controller and implements a POST handler to initiate database creation.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a database by invoking AppSetupUtility. Returns error information if creation fails.
